title: SdkPythonPackageBoundaryV1
description: MBR-909: the declared distribution boundary for the membrane-client Python package. Encodes 'publish the SDK, not the core app' as data: which top-level importable packages the sdist/wheel may contain, which repository path prefixes must never appear inside it, and which file extensions (native binaries, installers, archives) are forbidden. tests/sdk/python_package_boundary_test.py reads this document plus dist/packages/python/pyproject.toml and the on-disk package tree, and fails if any of them drift from this declaration. Canonical instance: packages/python/package-boundary.v1.json.

packageRoot.description: Repository-relative directory setuptools resolves packages from (pyproject.toml [tool.setuptools.packages.find].where).

forbiddenPathPrefixes.description: Repository-relative path prefixes that must never be reachable from this package's build metadata (the core app, other SDKs, and tooling).

forbiddenFileExtensions.description: File suffixes that would indicate a bundled native binary, installer, or archive rather than pure Python source/metadata.

runtimeDependencies.description: Declared [project].dependencies. Must stay empty for a thin transport-injected client.
